title: Mask-assisted spacer self-trimming
description:
A subresolution feature on the photomask may be processed to generate a sloped sidewall that allows the spacer to be etched away. The process is a low-contrast development process such as used for developable BARCs.
References
F. T. Chen et al., Proc. SPIE vol. 8683, 868311 (2013).
U.S. Patent 6114071.
U.S. Patent 8715891.
author: Guiding light
